Nalanda University : Education System
# Nalanda's entrance exam was highly selective and multi-stage, with "dwarapandits" (gatekeepers) quizzing students on logic and grammar; only a few passed.
# The curriculum included five main subjects: grammar, crafts, medicine, logic, and philosophy.
# Teaching methods involved both 'Pariyatti' (lectures) and 'Paripatti' (practical application and debates), with a structured academic calendar.
